title: PawNet
tagline: PawNet is a digital dog database where each dog gets a unique ID, making it easy to track vaccinations, manage breeder info, and help reunite lost dogs with their owners #Web3 #DogTech
description: PawNet is a database for dogs, where each dog is assigned a unique ID that serves as its digital identity. This system streamlines the tracking of vaccination records(and check vaccine validity), enabling easy access to proof of vaccination for scenarios such as flight clearance(in plans). Additionally, it provides breeders and their customers with detailed information management tools. A key feature of our platform is the ability to track lost dogs and offer rewards to those who help reunite them with their owners.
how_its_made:
This project use
* next.js for frontend with typescript
* hardhat for contracts development
* solidity as a main smart contract language with use of openzeppelin contracts
* we use morphl2 solution as a main chain. It provides us with following benefits
    1) Easy to build, as it 100% EVM compatible
    2) Potential for further multichain usage(again due to 100% EVM compatible)
    3) Low fees
    4) Faster staking/unstaking
* We use Envio HyperIndex as an indexer service. It allows us to easy index our contract events, and store data in convenient structure with easy access from frontend.
